journals.title: The Philosophy Behind K2.OS
journals.content:
Unlike Everest, K2 is known for being difficult, demanding, and unforgiving. Success requires preparation, discipline, teamwork, adaptability, and resilience.

Everyone is climbing their own mountain. K2.OS is intended to act as a personal basecamp, navigation system, and command center for that journey.
